name: Tamil NLP Classification
description:
Built a comprehensive NLP text classification pipeline tailored specifically for the Tamil language.
Implemented TF-IDF vectorization and trained Naive Bayes, SVM, and Logistic Regression models from scratch.
Delivered robust news category prediction and sentiment analysis, successfully navigating low-resource language constraints.

name: Kafka Chat Application
description:
Engineered a Signal-inspired real-time distributed chat application with highly durable message pipelines.
Implemented using Node.js microservices, WebSockets, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and AES-256-GCM transport encryption.
Achieved reliable delivery semantics with idempotent writes, dead-letter queues, and horizontally scalable gateways.

name: Meta-Agent Framework
description:
Engineered an intelligent LLM orchestration framework that dynamically designs and executes specialized AI agents.
Constructed using FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Redis, and ChromaDB atop a graph-based execution runtime.
Automated complex pipelines by enabling autonomous system planning, resilient self-healing loops, and secure tool execution.

name: LS-FLSTSVM Imbalance Learning
description:
Designed a high-performance machine learning implementation for solving imbalanced binary classification tasks.
Leveraged Least Squares Fuzzy Twin Support Vector Machines (LS-FLSTSVM) and LSSMO solver in Python.
Achieved over 90% accuracy on breast cancer datasets, effectively down-weighting noisy minority class samples.

name: Collaborative Code Editor
description:
Developed a real-time collaborative code editor platform for seamless remote pair programming.
Built using React, Vite, Yjs, Node.js, and Monaco Editor within a scalable monorepo architecture.
Delivered instant synchronization and conflict-free editing, solving remote developer collaboration friction.

name: CargoLink
description:
Developed a comprehensive logistics web platform connecting customers with transporters for efficient goods delivery.
Architected using React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Redis within a Dockerized GCP environment.
Streamlined bidding workflows and ensured consistent application behavior across scalable CI/CD deployments.
